newsitem.title: CHINA: China Feb money supply growth lowest since 1994.
newsitem.headline: China Feb money supply growth lowest since 1994.

text.p: Chinese money supply growth in February dropped to its lowest level since 1994, the Xinhua agency on Friday quoted a central bank report as saying.
China's financial situation was stable during January and February, the agency quoted the report by the People's Bank of China as saying.
It gave no figure for money supply in the period and did not specify the money supply measurement to which it was referring.

Xinhua said money supply growth had followed a downward trend in the first two months due to a small increase in central bank investment, slower growth in foreign exchange reserves and efforts to recover central bank loans from commercial banks.
State media have forecast China's broad M2 money supply will rise a year-on-year 24.5 percent in 1997. M2 grew 25.3 percent last year.
